The '''electroguillotine'''<ref name="name origin">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep504|text="The Soft War" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> was a device used in executions by beheading the condemned. An [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] could be used to activate an electroguillotine.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>

==History==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 44]] {{C|20 BBY 43-46: Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> an electroguillotine was to be used in the execution of [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], but the event was interrupted by the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].<ref name=":0" />
